name: Ego Preservation and Autonomous Choice Architecture
scenario: Requiring a resistant commercial client to conform to rigid architectural security guidelines.
script: "We have two security compliance frameworks that satisfy our SOC-2 Type II audit obligations: Model Alpha provides automated daily log ingest, while Model Beta mandates weekly manual penetration validations. Which of those two configurations fits your team's operational culture?"
defense: Reject the binary: neither model fits; require a hybrid that automates API monitoring without weekly manual work.
originFull: Self-Determination Theory and Psychological Reactance demonstrate that individuals aggressively reject proposals—even advantageous ones—if they feel their fundamental agency and autonomy are being constrained.
defenseFull: When bounded within an artificial binary choice designed to manufacture an illusion of control: "Neither Model Alpha nor Model Beta accommodates our automated development pipeline. We require a hybrid option that automates continuous API monitoring without manual weekly intervention."
